# Ayaz Ul Haq, Technical Lead

> Ayaz Ul Haq is a technical lead at Techinoid in Lahore, Pakistan, with ten years of experience on .NET and Azure. He works directly with clients, plans sprints, leads teams of three to seven engineers and writes code himself. He uses Claude Code and Codex in his day-to-day work.

## Pages

- [Work](https://ayazulhaq.com/projects.html): fleet tracking and scheduling on Azure Service Bus and Functions (about 20,000 pings a day), health information systems for the Saudi Ministry of Health deployed on site, and an airline integration monolith split into services.
- [Architecture](https://ayazulhaq.com/architecture.html): diagrams of other systems he has built or worked on, with functional names only.
- [Notes](https://ayazulhaq.com/notes.html): engineering notes.
- [About](https://ayazulhaq.com/about.html): career history, education and stack.
